title: Building a safer path to autonomous industrial AI
hook_text: Industrial AI is entering the physical world.
hook_before: Industrial AI is moving from digital screens into physical factories.
script:
Industrial AI just left the screen and entered the factory.
Foundation models and agentic AI are automating complex tasks.
Unlike purely digital software, these systems interact directly with real hardware.
Engineers are now building rigorous safety frameworks before deployment.
Would you trust an autonomous robot in your workplace?
